children.text: Conversation 1
children.cn: 对话1

children.text: John, what do you want to be when you grow up?
children.speaker: Susan
children.cn: 约翰，你长大后想成为什么样的人？
children.notes: grow up = 长大
children.statement: 这句话询问的是职业理想。
children.explanation: What do you want to be... 用于询问理想职业。
children.highlight: what do you want to be

children.text: I want to be a fireman.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我想成为一名消防员。
children.notes: fireman = 消防队员
children.statement: John 想当消防员。
children.explanation: 根据回答 I want to be a fireman. 可知。

children.text: Wow! But why?
children.speaker: Susan
children.cn: 哇！但为什么呢？

children.text: Well, my uncle is a firefighter. He is like a hero to me. So I want to be just like him.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 嗯，我叔叔是一名消防员。他对我来说就像个英雄。所以我想变得跟他一样。
children.notes: firefighter = 消防员
children.statement: John 的叔叔是一名消防员。
children.explanation: 根据下文 my uncle is a firefighter 可知。

children.text: So how are you going to become a fireman?
children.speaker: Susan
children.cn: 那你打算怎样成为一名消防员呢？

children.text: I'm going to exercise every day, because a fireman needs to be strong.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我打算每天锻炼，因为消防员需要强壮。
children.notes: be going to = 打算，将要
children.statement: John 打算每天锻炼以保持强壮。
children.explanation: 根据回答可知 John 计划每天锻炼。

children.text: Yes, you need to be really fit.
children.speaker: Susan
children.cn: 是的，你需要非常健美。

children.text: Conversation 2
children.cn: 对话2

children.text: Tina, what do you want to be when you grow up?
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 蒂娜，你长大后想成为什么样的人？

children.text: I want to be a fashion designer.
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 我想成为一名时装设计师。
children.notes: fashion designer = 时装设计师
children.statement: Tina 想成为一名时装设计师。
children.explanation: 根据 Tina 的回答可知。

children.text: Cool! How are you going to do that?
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 太酷了！你打算怎么做？

children.text: I'm going to take art lessons and practise my drawing skills every day.
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 我打算上美术课，每天练习绘画技巧。
children.statement: Tina 打算通过上美术课和练习绘画来实现梦想。
children.explanation: 句中提及 take art lessons 和 practise my drawing skills。

children.text: That sounds great! What about you, Jason? What do you want to be when you're older?
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 听起来不错！那你呢，贾森？你年纪大一点后想做什么？

children.text: I want to be an IT engineer.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 我想成为一名IT工程师。
children.notes: IT engineer = IT工程师
children.statement: Jason 想成为一名 IT 工程师。
children.explanation: 根据 Jason 的回答可知。

children.text: Nice! How do you plan to do that?
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 不错！你计划怎么做？

children.text: I'm going to work hard at maths. And I'm also going to read more books about IT and AI.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 我打算努力学数学。而且我还打算读更多关于IT和人工智能的书。
children.notes: AI = artificial intelligence 人工智能
children.statement: Jason 打算努力学数学并阅读更多关于 IT 和 AI 的书。
children.explanation: 根据 Jason 的原话可知其具体计划。

children.text: Fu Xing's Reading and Dream
children.cn: 福兴的阅读与梦想

children.text: What are you reading, Fu Xing?
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 福兴，你在读什么呢？

children.text: It's a book of essays by a famous Chinese writer.
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 这是一本中国著名作家的散文集。
children.notes: essay = 散文，小品文
children.statement: 这本书是一本中国著名作家的散文集。
children.explanation: 根据 Fu Xing 的回答可知。

children.text: Wow, now I know why you're so good at writing.
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 哇，现在我知道为什么你写作这么好了。

children.text: Thanks! You know, I want to be a writer when I'm older.
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 谢谢！你知道的，我年纪大一点后想成为一名作家。
children.notes: writer = 作家
children.statement: Fu Xing 想成为一名作家。
children.explanation: 根据 I want to be a writer 可知。

children.text: Really? How do you plan to do that?
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 真的吗？你打算怎么实现这个目标？

children.text: I'm going to read more classics. And also, I'm going to keep on writing stories and essays.
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 我打算读更多经典作品。并且，我还打算继续写故事和散文。
children.notes: classic = 经典作品；keep on doing sth = 继续做某事
children.statement: Fu Xing 打算阅读更多经典并坚持写作。
children.explanation: 根据 Fu Xing 的具体计划可知。

children.text: Adam's Future Plans
children.cn: 亚当的未来计划

children.text: Your plan sounds wonderful! I think you're going to be a great writer.
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 你的计划听起来棒极了！我认为你会成为一名伟大的作家。

children.text: I hope so! What about you, Adam? What do you want to be when you're older?
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 但愿如此！那你呢，亚当？你年纪大一点后想做什么？
children.keywords: I hope so, what about you

children.text: My parents want me to be a doctor, but I'm not sure about that.
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 我父母想让我当医生，但我对此不确定。
children.notes: doctor = 医生
children.statement: Adam 的父母希望他成为一名医生。
children.explanation: 根据 My parents want me to be a doctor 可知。

children.text: Well, don't worry. Not everyone knows what they want to be.
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 嗯，别担心。不是每个人都知道自己想做什么。

children.text: Just make sure you try your best at school. Then you can do anything you want!
children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.cn: 只要确保你在学校尽力就行。然后你就能做任何你想做的事！
children.notes: make sure = 确保；try one's best = 尽某人最大努力
children.statement: Fu Xing 劝 Adam 不用着急，在学校尽力就好。
children.explanation: 根据对话内容可知 Fu Xing 给予了鼓励。

children.text: Yeah, you're right.
children.speaker: Adam
children.cn: 是的，你是对的。

children.text: Paragraph 1: Definition of Resolutions
children.cn: 第一段：决议的定义

children.text: Do you know what a resolution is?
children.cn: 你知道什么是决心（新年愿望）吗？
children.notes: resolution = 决定，决议，决心
children.statement: 文章开头用问句引出什么是 resolution。
children.explanation: 首句 Do you know what a resolution is? 是疑问句。

children.text: A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
children.cn: 决心就是你对自己许下的诺言。
children.notes: promise = 承诺，诺言
children.statement: resolution 的定义是自己对自己的承诺。
children.explanation: 根据句子 A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself. 可知。

children.text: People make resolutions to improve their life.
children.cn: 人们下决心是为了改善他们的生活。
children.notes: improve = 改善，提高
children.statement: 人们做决定的目的是为了改善生活。
children.explanation: 根据句子 People make resolutions to improve their life. 可知。

children.text: The most common kind is a New Year's resolution.
children.cn: 最常见的一种是新年愿望（新年决心）。
children.notes: common = 常见的
children.statement: 最常见的决心是新年决心。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出 The most common kind is a New Year's resolution.

children.text: After all, the start of the year is often a perfect time for making resolutions.
children.cn: 毕竟，一年的开始通常是许下新年决心的绝佳时机。
children.notes: After all = 毕竟；perfect = 完美的
children.statement: 年初是许下决心的好时机。
children.explanation: 对应选项 D 的内容。
children.keywords: start of the year, perfect time

children.text: Paragraph 2: Types of Resolutions
children.cn: 第二段：决心的类型

children.text: Resolutions can be about anything.
children.cn: 决心可以关于任何事情。

children.text: Some are about physical health.
children.cn: 有些关于身体健康。
children.notes: physical = 身体的；health = 健康
children.statement: 有些决心与身体健康有关。
children.explanation: 根据句子 Some are about physical health. 可知。

children.text: For example, some people may promise to exercise more or eat more healthily.
children.cn: 例如，有些人可能会承诺多锻炼或吃得更健康。
children.notes: healthily = 健康地
children.statement: 锻炼身体和健康饮食是常见的身体健康决心。
children.explanation: 根据例句可知。

children.text: People might decide they are going to take up a hobby, like painting or photography.
children.cn: 人们可能会决定培养一项爱好，比如画画或摄影。
children.notes: take up = 开始从事，学着做；photography = 摄影
children.statement: 人们可能会决定培养绘画或摄影等爱好。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Some resolutions have to do with learning new things.
children.cn: 有些决心与学习新事物有关。
children.notes: have to do with = 与……有关系
children.statement: 有些决心和学习新事物有关。
children.explanation: 对应选项 A 的内容。

children.text: And some resolutions have to do with self-improvement, like becoming more confident or organized.
children.cn: 还有一些决心与自我完善有关，比如变得更加自信或更有条理。
children.notes: self-improvement = 自我改进；confident = 自信的；organized = 有条理的
children.statement: 自我提升也是决心的一种类型。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: For example, a student may decide to start a new study plan.
children.cn: 例如，学生可能会决定开始一个新的学习计划。
children.statement: 学生可能会制定新的学习计划作为自我提升的一部分。
children.explanation: 对应选项 B 的内容。

children.text: Paragraph 3: Why People Fail
children.cn: 第三段：为什么人们做不到

children.text: Although there are differences, most resolutions have one thing in common: People hardly ever keep them!
children.cn: 尽管存在差异,大多数决心都有一个共同点：人们几乎从不坚持它们！
children.notes: hardly ever = 几乎不；keep = 保持，坚持
children.statement: 大多数人很难坚持自己的决心。
children.explanation: 根据 People hardly ever keep them! 可知。

children.text: But there are good reasons for this.
children.cn: 但这背后有很好的理由。

children.text: Sometimes the resolutions may be too difficult to keep.
children.cn: 有时候决心可能太难而无法坚持。
children.statement: 决心太难是人们放弃的原因之一。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: And sometimes people just forget about them.
children.cn: 有时人们只是把它们忘了。
children.statement: 人们会忘记自己的决心。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Paragraphs 4 & 5: How to Make Resolutions Work
children.cn: 第四、五段：如何让决心发挥作用

children.text: To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely.
children.cn: 为了让你的决心奏效，你需要明智地规划它们。
children.notes: wisely = 明智地
children.statement: 我们需要明智地规划决心。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Always make sure your resolution is possible to achieve.
children.cn: 务必确保你的决心是可以实现的。
children.notes: make sure = 确保；achieve = 实现，达到
children.statement: 决心必须是可能实现的。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Don't set a goal that is too difficult or too much for you.
children.cn: 不要设定对你来说太难或负担过重目标。
children.statement: 不应设定过于困难的目标。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution.
children.cn: 尝试设定小目标来帮助你实现决心。
children.notes: mini-goal = 小目标
children.statement: 设定小目标有助于实现决心。
children.explanation: 对应选项 C 的内容。

children.text: And if you don't want to forget your resolutions, write them down.
children.cn: 如果你不想忘记你的决心，把它们写下来。
children.notes: write down = 写下
children.statement: 写下来可以防止忘记决心。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Also, talk about them with your family and friends.
children.cn: 此外，和你的家人朋友谈论它们。
children.statement: 可以与亲友谈论自己的决心。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: Encourage them to remind you of your goals.
children.cn: 鼓励他们提醒你你的目标。
children.notes: encourage = 鼓励；remind = 提醒
children.statement: 应该鼓励亲友提醒自己的目标。
children.explanation: 根据句子可知。

children.text: So what resolutions are you going to make?
children.cn: 那么你打算许下什么决心呢？
children.keywords: resolutions are you going to make

children.text: How are you going to keep them?
children.cn: 你打算如何坚持它们？

children.text: This person helps to put out fires.
children.cn: 这个人帮忙扑灭火灾。
children.notes: put out = 扑灭
children.statement: 灭火的人是消防员。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 fireman。

children.text: This person is good at playing music.
children.cn: 这个人擅长演奏音乐。
children.statement: 擅长音乐的人是音乐家。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 musician。

children.text: This person acts in a play or a film.
children.cn: 这个人短剧或电影中表演。
children.statement: 在戏剧或电影中表演的人是演员。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 actor / actress。

children.text: This person designs or builds machines, roads, or bridges.
children.cn: 这个人设计或建造机器、道路或桥梁。
children.statement: 设计或建造机器、桥梁的人是工程师。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 engineer。

children.text: This person designs clothes, shoes, or other items for people.
children.cn: 这个人为人设计衣服、鞋子或其他物品。
children.statement: 设计服装鞋帽的人是设计师。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 designer。

children.text: This person gives advice to people about the law.
children.cn: 这个人就法律问题向人们提供建议。
children.statement: 提供法律建议的人是律师。
children.explanation: 根据定义可知这是 lawyer。

children.text: Summertime: Hard Work vs Relaxing
In the Farmer's Field
It was summertime.
children.cn: 那是夏天的时候。
children.notes: summertime = 夏季，夏天
children.statement: 故事发生的初始季节是夏天。
children.explanation: 句中明确指出 It was summertime。

children.text: The ant and the grasshopper were in the farmer's field.
children.cn: 蚂蚁和蚂蚱在农夫的田地里。
children.notes: farmer's field = 农夫的田地
children.statement: 蚂蚁和蚂蚱在热闹的城市街道上。
children.explanation: 他们在农夫的田地里（in the farmer's field）。

children.text: The ant was busy collecting corn.
children.cn: 蚂蚁正忙着收集玉米。
children.notes: be busy doing sth = 忙于做某事
children.statement: be busy doing sth 结构中，busy 后面接动名词。
children.explanation: be busy doing sth 表示忙着做某事，后接动名词形式。

children.text: The grasshopper was relaxing in the sun.
children.cn: 蚂蚱正在阳光下悠闲地放松。
children.notes: relaxing in the sun = 在阳光下放松
children.statement: 蚂蚱也在辛勤地搬运食物准备过冬。
children.explanation: 蚂蚱正在阳光下悠闲地休息（relaxing in the sun）。

children.text: "Hey, Ant, come sit with me," said the grasshopper.
children.speaker: Grasshopper
children.cn: “嘿，蚂蚁，过来和我一起坐坐吧，”蚂蚱说。
children.notes: come sit with me = 过来和我一起坐
children.statement: 蚂蚱邀请蚂蚁停下工作过来一起坐坐。
children.explanation: 蚂蚱对蚂蚁说 come sit with me。
children.keywords: come sit with me, said grasshopper

children.text: "No, thanks," said the ant. "I have to take this corn home. I'm preparing for the winter."
children.speaker: Ant
children.cn: “不，谢谢，”蚂蚁说。“我得把这玉米运回家。我正在为冬天做准备。”
children.notes: have to = 必须，不得不；prepare for = 为……做准备
children.statement: 蚂蚁接受了蚂蚱的邀请，坐下来一起晒太阳。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁礼貌拒绝并继续搬运玉米为冬天做准备。
children.keywords: take corn home, preparing for winter

children.text: Late Summer: The Contrast Continues
Playing Music vs Storing Food
A few weeks later, summer was almost at an end.
children.cn: 几周之后，夏天快要结束了。
children.notes: at an end = 结束
children.statement: at an end 意思是“即将结束”。
children.explanation: at an end 表示结束、终结。
children.keywords: few weeks later, summer, at an end

children.text: The ant continued to take corn home every day, but the grasshopper just played his violin and danced around.
children.cn: 蚂蚁每天继续把玉米运回家，但蚂蚱只是拉着小提琴到处跳舞。
children.notes: continue to do sth = 继续做某事；played his violin = 拉小提琴
children.statement: play 后接乐器名词时通常加定冠词 the，但在有物主代词 his 时省略 the。
children.explanation: 有物主代词 his 时，不需要再加 the。
children.keywords: continued, take corn, played violin, danced

children.text: "Come on, Ant!" said the grasshopper. "Dance with me!"
children.speaker: Grasshopper
children.cn: “来吧，蚂蚁！”蚂蚱说。“和我一起跳舞吧！”
children.notes: Dance with me = 祈使句
children.statement: 蚂蚱邀请蚂蚁一起跳舞。
children.explanation: 蚂蚱热情地喊蚂蚁过来跳舞。

children.text: "No," replied the ant. "I'm going to get more corn. Why don't you join me? You should plan for the winter."
children.speaker: Ant
children.cn: “不，”蚂蚁回答道。“我去弄更多的玉米。你为什么不和我一起呢？你应该为冬天做计划。”
children.notes: Why don't you... = 为什么不……（提建议）；plan for = 为……做计划
children.statement: Why don't you do sth 用于提出建议，意为“你为什么不做……呢”。
children.explanation: Why don't you 是提建议的常用句型。
children.keywords: get more corn, Why don't you join, plan for winter

children.text: "But the winter is so far away! Your work looks so boring! Come with me! Let's have a picnic!"
children.speaker: Grasshopper
children.cn: “可是冬天还很遥远呢！你的工作看起来真无聊！跟我来吧！咱们去野餐！”
children.notes: so far away = 如此遥远；have a picnic = 去野餐
children.statement: 蚂蚱认为冬天马上就要到了，必须抓紧时间野餐。
children.explanation: 蚂蚱觉得冬天还很遥远（winter is so far away）。
children.keywords: winter so far away, work boring, picnic

children.text: "No, thanks, Grasshopper. I'm going to continue with my boring work."
children.speaker: Ant
children.cn: “不，谢谢你，蚂蚱。我打算继续做我这无聊的工作。”
children.notes: continue with sth = 继续做某事
children.statement: 蚂蚁坚持继续完成储存食物的工作。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁决定继续脚踏实地工作。

children.text: Autumn: Cool Winds and Gathering Wood
The Weather Changes
The grasshopper was silent for a while, but then he happily danced away.
children.cn: 蚂蚱沉默了一会儿，但随后又欢快地跳着舞走开了。
children.notes: for a while = 一会儿；happily = 快乐地（副词修饰danced）
children.statement: happily 是副词，用来修饰动词 danced。
children.explanation: happily 修饰动词 danced，表示欢快地跳舞。
children.keywords: silent for a while, happily danced away

children.text: The ant looked tired, but she felt happy when she saw all the food in her kitchen.
children.cn: 蚂蚁看起来很累，但当她看到厨房里所有的食物时，她感到很欣慰快乐。
children.notes: looked tired = 看起来疲惫；when引导时间状语从句
children.statement: 看到厨房里满满的食物，蚂蚁感到非常后悔。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁看到食物后感到开心满足（felt happy）。
children.keywords: looked tired, felt happy, food in kitchen

children.text: The autumn arrived and the weather became cool and windy.
children.cn: 秋天到了，天气变得凉爽而多风。
children.notes: became cool and windy = 系表结构，形容词作表语
children.statement: 秋天到来后，天气变得炎热而潮湿。
children.explanation: 文中说天气变得凉爽多风（cool and windy）。
children.keywords: autumn arrived, weather became cool and windy

children.text: The grasshopper ran around the farm singing songs.
children.cn: 蚂蚱在农场周围到处跑，唱着歌。
children.notes: singing songs = 现在分词短语作伴随状语
children.statement: singing songs 在句中作伴随状语。
children.explanation: 现在分词短语 singing songs 表示跑的同时伴随的动作。

children.text: The poor ant had to fight her way through the wind.
children.cn: 可怜的蚂蚁不得不在大风中艰难前行。
children.notes: fight one's way through = 在……中艰难前行/奋力穿过
children.statement: fight one's way through 意为“奋力穿过，艰难前行”。
children.explanation: fight one's way through 是形象生动的动词短语。
children.keywords: poor ant, fight way through wind

children.text: She wanted to collect lots of wood.
children.cn: 她想收集大量的木柴。
children.notes: collect lots of wood = 收集很多木柴
children.statement: 蚂蚁收集木柴是为了在寒冬里生火取暖。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁为了冬天取暖而储备柴火（want to be warm in the winter）。
children.keywords: wanted to collect, lots of wood

children.text: "Ant, it's too windy to work!" said the grasshopper. "Come and sing with me!"
children.speaker: Grasshopper
children.cn: “蚂蚁，风太大了不能干活！”蚂蚱说。“来和我一起唱歌吧！”
children.notes: too... to... = 太……而不能……
children.statement: too windy to work 意思是“风太大而无法工作”。
children.explanation: too... to... 结构表示否定意义“太……以至于不能……”。
children.keywords: too windy to work, Come and sing

children.text: "No, thanks, Grasshopper. There's just a little bit more work for me to do. I want to be warm in the winter."
children.speaker: Ant
children.cn: “不，谢谢你，蚂蚱。我只剩一点点活要做了。我想在冬天里保暖。”
children.notes: a little bit more = 再多一点点；warm in the winter = 冬天保暖
children.statement: 蚂蚁只想在冬天挨冻，所以拒绝了蚂蚱。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁是为了在冬天能烤火保暖（want to be warm in the winter）。
children.keywords: little bit more work, warm in winter

children.text: Winter Arrives: The Harsh Reality
A Knock at the Door
And then the cold winter came.
children.cn: 然后寒冷的冬天到来了。
children.notes: the cold winter came = 寒冬降临
children.statement: 冬天终于到来了。
children.explanation: 文章进入了第四个阶段：寒冬降临。

children.text: The ant sat at home by her fire, enjoying some lovely corn soup.
children.cn: 蚂蚁坐在家里的火炉旁，享用着美味的玉米浓汤。
children.notes: by her fire = 在炉火旁；enjoying = 现在分词作伴随状语
children.statement: 蚂蚁在冬天又冷又饿，没有火也没有食物。
children.explanation: 蚂蚁在火炉边舒适地享用着玉米汤（sat by her fire, enjoying corn soup）。
children.keywords: sat at home, by fire, corn soup

children.text: Then she heard a knock at the door.
children.cn: 这时她听到了敲门声。
children.notes: heard a knock at the door = 听到敲门声
children.statement: knock 在这里是名词，意为“敲击声”。
children.explanation: a knock 作 heard 的宾语，是名词用法。

children.text: "Oh, dear Ant," said the grasshopper, "you must help me! I have no food! And no fire to keep me warm!"
children.speaker: Grasshopper
children.cn: “噢，亲爱的蚂蚁，”蚂蚱说，“你一定要帮帮我！我没有食物！也没有炉火让我保暖！”
children.notes: must help = 必须帮助；to keep me warm = 动词不定式作定语
children.statement: 蚂蚱带着充足的食物和燃料来拜访蚂蚁。
children.explanation: 蚂蚱饥寒交迫，向蚂蚁求救（have no food, no fire）。
children.keywords: must help me, no food, no fire, keep me warm

children.text: "Sorry, Grasshopper, you must learn to look after yourself. Keep dancing and singing through the winter, and work hard when spring comes!"
children.speaker: Ant
children.cn: “抱歉，蚂蚱，你必须学会照顾好你自己。在整个冬天里继续跳舞唱歌吧，等春天来了再努力工作！”
children.notes: look after yourself = 照顾好你自己；Keep doing sth = 保持做某事
children.statement: yourself 是反身代词，意为“你自己”。
children.explanation: look after yourself 中的 yourself 是反身代词。
children.keywords: look after yourself, Keep dancing and singing, work hard
